gen-fs-chubbo-gf-solway: Chubbo draws smooth, marker-tip letters that glide around every bend without a snag. Then Solway steps in as a text serif, flat in its line weight and generous at the eye of the e, so a long page stays bookish and easy to settle into.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-laila: Oswald packs its rows tight and stands tall, confident and strong. Laila follows in serif, with generous gaps where curves leave the stem, so longer reading feels editorial and traditional, never cramped.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil comes in modern, with big round bowls and half-unwrapped curves. Almendra Display sits above it, ornate and literary, and a long passage moves from that decorative heading into a body that feels open and current.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-manrope: Friendly and tightly packed, Pramukh Rounded bunches its glyphs close, with bowls like a tipped ladle. But Manrope looks drawn with a ruler and compass, its sans-serif curves wide open at the mouth, so the two read as snug on top and bright below.
gen-orbitron-gf-ovo: Minimal and widely spaced, Orbitron has the line weight of a technical drawing pen. And Ovo, a classic serif with thins barely lighter than its stems, feels warm and authoritative beside that precision.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-yuji-boku: Soft marker-tip roundness from Chubbo meets a serif where every stroke holds one thickness, like a drawn cable. Chubbo is best at casual, inviting display lettering; Yuji Boku is best at dignified, editorial text.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-fenix: Confident, tightly knit Oswald leads with strength. Fenix, a text serif with curved strokes that end before they turn inward, sounds classic and editorial, and giving it a little more size lets those curves breathe.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-telugu: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut, with a pronounced x-height. Make it small and that charm shrinks.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-satoshi: Pramukh Rounded packs its glyphs tight, with open bowls and large lowercase forms, in a friendly voice. Its place is big and short, while Satoshi's sans-serif strokes stay cut to one width.
gen-orbitron-gf-domine: Domine is a text serif with compact ascenders over tall lowercase and a slight pinch where curves meet stems, refined and dignified. Its dignity against Orbitron's wide-spaced precision is the pair's strongest quality.
